# Menghour — Product Designer & Creative Director from Cambodia

> Menghour Lao is a Cambodian product designer and creative director based in Phnom Penh, Cambodia, with over 7 years of professional experience. He builds digital products for startups and growth-stage companies across Southeast Asia and globally — from zero-to-one mobile apps to scaled design systems.

## Identity

- **Full name**: Menghour Lao
- **Role**: Product Designer & Creative Director
- **Nationality**: Cambodian
- **Location**: Phnom Penh, Cambodia
- **Languages**: Khmer (native), English (fluent)
- **Email**: laomenghour@gmail.com
- **Available for**: Freelance product design, UI/UX, branding, and creative consulting

## About

Menghour is a product designer from Cambodia who has spent over 7 years helping startups and growth-stage companies across Southeast Asia turn ambitious ideas into elegant, considered digital products. His work spans mobile apps, web platforms, design systems, graphic design, and brand identity.

Beyond design, Menghour is a street photographer and writer. He documents life through his camera — primarily on the streets of Phnom Penh — and shares thoughts on design and visual storytelling on Medium.

## Skills & Services

- Product Design (UI/UX)
- Graphic Design & Branding
- Design Systems
- User Research & Product Psychology
- Product Photography
- Motion Graphics
- Project Management
- Creative Direction

## Selected Work

- **BookMe+** (2024–Present) — Lead product designer on BookMe+, an ongoing booking platform product. Currently in active development.
- **Hang Meas Mobile** — UI/UX redesign for Hang Meas Media Group, Cambodia's leading television and media company.
- **BookMeBus** — UI/UX design for BookMeBus, one of Southeast Asia's largest bus ticket booking platforms.
- **VET Airbus** — Product design for VET Airbus transportation service.
- **VDEUK** — Product design engagement.
- **VTENH** — Product design engagement.
- **GTVC Speedboat** — Transportation service product design.
